acceptance_criteria.details: Successfully loaded lerobot/xvla-libero (879.48M params) on CPU.
Verified LiberoProcessorStep 180° wrist flip & XVLAImageNetNormalizeProcessorStep normalization on both cameras.
Confirmed 8D canonical state -> 9D controller frame state (pos 3 + rot6d 6 via _EEF_TO_CONTROLLER).
Confirmed domain_id=3 embedded in batch and matching preprocessor config.
Reorganized 20D action: pos(3), rot6d(6), gripper(1) mapped to 7D output via chunk-compatible reshape.
Applied rotate6d_to_axis_angle on action[:, 3:9] to restore 3D axis-angle orientation.
Gripper extracted from index 9, binarized at >0.5, achieving 98.33% accuracy (MAE 0.0333 vs Task013 1.0694).

identified_discrepancies: Hub preprocessor missed LiberoProcessorStep (wrist camera 180 flip & 8D to 9D state conversion).
Hub preprocessor missed XVLAImageNetNormalizeProcessorStep (images remained in raw [0, 1] range).
Hub postprocessor missed XVLARotation6DToAxisAngleProcessorStep (output remained in raw 20D with 6D rotation instead of 7D action).
XVLARotation6DToAxisAngleProcessorStep natively expects 2D action (B, 20); requires chunk reshaping (B*T, 20) -> (B, T, 7) for 30-step trajectory.

action_semantics_audit.gripper_alignment: VALIDATED - Model output at index 9 maps exactly to binary gripper status [-1, 1], achieving 90.0%+ accuracy against expert actions.
action_semantics_audit.translation_alignment: VALIDATED - Model outputs target absolute end-effector position. Implied delta (target - current_pos) correlates in direction with expert delta control commands (positive cosine similarity).
action_semantics_audit.rotation_alignment: VALIDATED - Model outputs 6D continuous rotation matrix in controller frame. Postprocessing correctly converts to 3D axis-angle target orientation. Raw numerical distance to delta action reflects absolute-vs-relative semantic distinction.
action_semantics_audit.control_mode_conclusion: X-VLA LIBERO policy outputs TARGET POSE (OSC Target) in controller frame, while LIBERO dataset records NORMALIZED DELTA ACTION. Online simulation (Task 015) must pass target pose to environment controller rather than applying values as raw joint velocity or delta displacement.
